original_description: Bring your creative vision to life with WonderWorks AI. Generate stunning images, cinematic video clips, multi-shot storyboards, original music, and immersive sound effects directly from your conversation. Turn a story idea into a visually consistent sequence of key images that can become a long-form video. Use detailed prompts and reference images to control composition, style, characters, and visual continuity. Animate images into video, direct camera movement and on-screen action, and create the perfect soundtrack for your story. Ideal for filmmakers, content creators, marketers, and anyone turning ideas into compelling visual experiences.
summary_ja: 画像・動画・絵コンテ・音楽・効果音を生成し、物語を映像化する制作を支援する。
limitations: 実動作・映像の一貫性・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
